name: Should I repair or replace my door threshold?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my door threshold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the extent and type of damage. If the damage is superficial, such as minor cracks, splinters, or worn-out sealant, a repair might suffice. However, if there's significant rot, severe warping, structural compromise, or if the threshold is old and continuously failing, replacement is usually the better long-term solution. A professional evaluation can help determine the most cost-effective and durable option for your specific situation, ensuring optimal performance and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose repair for superficial damage; opt for replacement if there is significant rot, warping, or structural compromise. A professional evaluation helps decide the best option.
